# controld_profile (Resource)

Manages a ControlD DNS profile. A profile groups filters, custom rules, and services that can be applied to one or more devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "controld_profile" "home" {
  name = "Home Network"
}

resource "controld_profile" "guest" {
  name             = "Guest Network"
  clone_profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the profile.

### Optional

- `clone_profile_id` (String) The identifier of an existing profile to clone when creating this profile. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `disable_ttl` (Number) The number of seconds after which the profile lock automatically expires. The ControlD API echoes this back as an update, but the controld-go client library this provider is built on doesn't expose it, so it can't be read back into state.
- `lock_message` (String) The message shown when the profile is locked. The ControlD API echoes this back on update, but the controld-go client library this provider is built on doesn't expose it, so it can't be read back into state.
- `lock_status` (Boolean) Whether the profile is locked, preventing further changes (including deletion). The ControlD API echoes this back on update, but the controld-go client library this provider is built on doesn't expose it, so it can't be read back into state.

**Warning:** setting this to `true` can leave the profile stuck. The `password` set alongside it does *not* reliably unlock the profile again through the API (confirmed against the live API: the same password is rejected with "Please provide a valid password"); unlocking may require your ControlD account login password via the web dashboard instead. `terraform destroy` will fail with the API's locked-profile error until the profile is unlocked by some other means. Avoid setting this attribute unless you have a tested way to unlock the profile again.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password associated with the profile. Never returned by the API. See the warning on `lock_status`: this value has not been confirmed to actually unlock a locked profile.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The profile identifier (PK).
- `updated` (Number) The Unix timestamp of the last update to the profile.
